mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_consumable_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM oa_consumable_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND create_key = #{key} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM oa_consumable_request WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND applicant_id = #{applicantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_consumable_request SET purpose = #{record.purpose}, apply_date = #{record.applyDate}, expect_date = #{record.expectDate}, total_amount = #{record.totalAmount}, issued_amount = #{record.issuedAmount}, returned_amount = #{record.returnedAmount}, status = #{record.status}, instance_id = #{record.instanceId}, submit_key = #{record.submitKey}, submit_hash = #{record.submitHash}, rule_snapshot = #{record.ruleSnapshot}, submit_time = #{record.submitTime}, issue_by = #{record.issueBy}, issue_time = #{record.issueTime}, cancel_by = #{record.cancelBy}, cancel_time = #{record.cancelTime}, cancel_reason = #{record.cancelReason}, update_by = #{record.updateBy}, update_time = #{record.updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{record.tenantId} AND request_id = #{record.requestId} AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{record.version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role membership JOIN sys_role role ON role.role_id = membership.role_id AND role.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND role.status = '0' AND role.deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role_menu permission ON permission.role_id = role.role_id AND permission.tenant_id = role.tenant_id JOIN sys_menu menu ON menu.menu_id = permission.menu_id AND menu.status = '0' WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.user_id = #{userId} AND menu.perms IN ('workflow:task:complete', '*:*:*')

SELECT revision.id AS revisionId, revision.version_no AS versionNo, revision.threshold_value AS thresholdValue, revision.effect, revision.enabled, revision.priority FROM sys_business_rule_version revision JOIN sys_business_rule rule ON rule.id = revision.rule_id AND rule.tenant_id = revision.tenant_id AND rule.rule_code = revision.rule_code WHERE revision.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND revision.rule_code = #{code} AND revision.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY revision.version_no DESC LIMIT 1
